Data Center Engineer
Location: Mountain View
Reports To: Director, Data Center Site Services

Position Overview
The Data Center Engineer (KTLO) is responsible for maintaining the continuous operational readiness of all critical infrastructure systems supporting a mission-critical data center environment. This role ensures uptime, preserves system redundancy, and enforces procedural and safety discipline across electrical, mechanical, and supporting site systems.
This is an operations-focused position centered on stability, execution, and compliance. The engineer executes approved procedures, supports structured change management activities, monitors system health, and maintains audit-ready documentation in a highly controlled, high-availability environment.
The role requires working knowledge of electrical distribution systems, critical cooling infrastructure (including liquid cooling technologies), structured MOP/SOP/EOP governance, and regulated operational environments. Success depends on procedural rigor, sound escalation judgment, and disciplined risk mitigation.

Key Responsibilities
Electrical Systems Operations
·         Operate and maintain UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, generators, fuel cells, and BESS (as applicable)
·         Support switching activities under approved MOPs
·         Monitor load distribution and system redundancy health
·         Validate restoration of redundancy following maintenance events
·         Support incident response and recovery activities
Mechanical & Cooling Systems
·         Operate and maintain critical cooling systems (air and liquid-based)
·         Support environments utilizing rear-door heat exchangers, CDUs, and direct-to-chip liquid cooling systems
·         Monitor thermal performance, delta-T, flow rates, and capacity utilization
·         Validate cooling system redundancy and leak detection mechanisms
·         Assess operational impact of cooling system maintenance or failure conditions
·         Validate system performance post-maintenance or change activity
Change Management & Documentation
·         Draft, review, and execute MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs
·         Participate in risk assessments and pre-task planning
·         Maintain accurate as-built documentation, labeling, and system diagrams
·         Capture validation evidence including alarms, trend data, and post-event reporting
Safety, Security & Compliance
·         Enforce LOTO and electrical safety standards
·         Support site access control and vendor oversight
·         Maintain audit readiness aligned with SOC 2 / ISO 27001 controls
·         Participate in emergency response and disaster recovery exercises

Qualifications
·         3+ years of experience in mission-critical facilities or data center operations
·         Working knowledge of medium and low voltage electrical systems
·         Experience with critical cooling infrastructure
·         Experience supporting liquid cooling systems (rear-door heat exchangers, CDU-based systems, or direct-to-chip environments) preferred
·         Familiarity with structured change management processes (MOP/SOP/EOP)
·         Experience in audited or regulated environments preferred
·         Experience with alternative energy systems (fuel cells, BESS, microgrid environments) a plus
·         Ability to work in a 24/7 operational environment

Core Competencies
·         Strong procedural discipline
·         Calm and methodical under pressure
·         Detail-oriented documentation practices
·         Clear communication and sound escalation judgment
·         Commitment to safety and operational integrity

Data Center Technician
Location: Mountain View
Reports To: Director, Data Center Site Services

Position Overview
The Data Center Technician supports the day-to-day operation and maintenance of critical infrastructure systems within a mission-critical data center environment. This role assists in maintaining uptime, monitoring system health, and executing approved procedures across electrical and mechanical systems.
This position focuses on hands-on operational support, preventive maintenance, documentation accuracy, and adherence to established safety and compliance standards. Work is performed under established procedures and direction from site leadership.

Key Responsibilities
Electrical Systems Support
·         Assist in monitoring and maintaining UPS systems, switchgear, transformers, PDUs, generators, fuel cells, and BESS (as applicable)
·         Support switching activities under approved MOPs and supervision
·         Record system readings and report abnormalities
·         Assist with redundancy checks following maintenance
Mechanical & Cooling Support
·         Support operation of critical cooling systems (air and liquid-based)
·         Assist with monitoring rear-door heat exchangers, CDUs, and direct-to-chip cooling systems
·         Record temperature, environmental, and flow data
·         Perform routine inspections of liquid cooling components and report abnormalities
·         Support leak detection and containment procedures
Documentation & Change Support
·         Execute approved MOPs, SOPs, and EOPs under supervision
·         Maintain accurate logs, maintenance records, and inspection checklists
·         Assist with vendor coordination and site access processes
·         Support post-maintenance documentation updates
Safety, Security & Compliance
·         Follow LOTO and electrical safety procedures
·         Support site access control and escort vendors as needed
·         Maintain compliance with site policies and audit requirements
·         Participate in emergency response drills and exercises

Qualifications
·         1–3 years of experience in data center, critical facilities, or industrial operations preferred
·         Basic understanding of electrical and/or mechanical systems
·         Exposure to liquid cooling environments (rear-door or direct-to-chip) a plus
·         Familiarity with structured procedures and documentation processes
·         Willingness to work in a 24/7 operational environment
·         Technical certification or trade background preferred

Core Competencies
·         Strong attention to detail
·         Willingness to follow established procedures
·         Clear communication and reporting
·         Safety-focused mindset
·         Ability to work effectively within a team environment
